meta.name: glycoengineering
meta.description: Analyze and engineer protein glycosylation. Scan sequences for N-glycosylation sequons (N-X-S/T), predict O-glycosylation hotspots, and access curated glycoengineering tools (NetOGlyc, GlycoShield, GlycoWorkbench). For glycoprotein engineering, therapeutic antibody optimization, and vaccine design.

copy.tagline: 分析蛋白糖基化位点，辅助抗体优化与疫苗设计
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正从事糖蛋白工程或治疗性抗体优化
copy.tagline_en: Analyze protein glycosylation sites to aid antibody optimization and vaccine design
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work on glycoprotein engineering or therapeutic antibody optimization

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能扫描蛋白质序列的 N-糖基化基序、预测 O-糖基化热点，并指导使用糖工程工具。
howto.when: 当用户提供蛋白质序列，或询问抗体工程、疫苗设计、蛋白稳定性优化时触发。

say.text: 分析 IgG1 Fc 区域的 N-糖基化位点。
say.note: Claude 会识别并列出所有 N-X-S/T 基序。

say.text: 预测这个蛋白质的 O-糖基化热点。
say.note: Claude 使用启发式算法评估 S/T 富集区域。

say.text: 帮我设计去除 N297 位糖基化的突变。
say.note: Claude 会给出 N297A 或 N297Q 突变建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can scan protein sequences for N-glycosylation sequons, predict O-glycosylation hotspots, and guide the use of glycoengineering tools.
howto.when_en: When the user provides a protein sequence or asks about antibody engineering, vaccine design, or protein stability optimization.

say_en.text: Analyze N-glycosylation sites in the IgG1 Fc region.
say_en.note: Claude identifies and lists all N-X-S/T motifs.

say_en.text: Predict O-glycosylation hotspots for this protein.
say_en.note: Claude uses a heuristic to assess S/T-rich regions.

say_en.text: Design a mutation to remove glycosylation at N297.
say_en.note: Claude suggests N297A or N297Q mutations.
